findings.spec_constraint: ISO 4914 UPI: Varchar(52); proprietary ID: Varchar(100)
findings.evidence_quote: Data Type & Format: ISO 4914 UPI: Varchar(52); or a proprietary ID: Varchar(100). Allowed Values: A valid ISO 4914 UPI code, or a proprietary identifier up to 100 characters
findings.reasoning: HKMA defines the field 'Unique Product Identifier (UPI)' which is mandated across OTC derivative asset classes including commodities (CM). The field accepts ISO 4914 UPI codes formatted as Varchar(52), which accommodates 12-character alphanumeric UPI codes without conflict.
